# SH-308: the corrected Flap set on the BNB test network (R1 anti-scam check, R3 pairing and no direct way, R4 Guardian
# beacons, the swap guard in the splitter and the shop) and one rules sale end to end on it ("Proof Jar", BNB rules: creator 10%,
# pile 60%, buy and burn 30%). Generated by hackathon/flap-redeploy/make-commands.py; read README.md beside it first.
# RPC=(the test network endpoint); lines run from the repository root of the MERGED checkout, after `forge build` in
# bounties/flap. Senders by keystore name: hack-deployer (address 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576),
# hack-alice (address 0x2908E3351ec8F20a8a6746773e42EA1D2FFb3c7F), and hack-bob
# (address 0xc979F6Cb8902f56f76b926358dC451cBF8f310F0); their password files under ~/.secrets (forge and cast read them).
# Gas price 0.1 gwei. NEW files only, in bounties/flap/deployments: the files named 97-v2.json, 97-v2-usdt.json,
# the two rules files 97-v2-rules-native.json and 97-v2-rules-usdt.json, and the sale's 97-v2-rules-native-sale.json; today's files there are
# fingerprinted in the first step and compared in the last. A forge dry line simulates and writes the file it would
# write; the send writes it again for real. NO comment line here starts with a digit after the hash and space except
# the steps.

# 1 preflight: today's deployment files fingerprinted (never written by this file), the module's answer, balances
mkdir -p .cache/flap-redeploy && { [ -s .cache/flap-redeploy/live-files.sha256 ] || sha256sum bounties/flap/deployments/97.json bounties/flap/deployments/97-*.json bounties/core/deployments/97-*.json | grep -v '/97-v2' > .cache/flap-redeploy/live-files.sha256; } && wc -l < .cache/flap-redeploy/live-files.sha256
ls bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2*.json bounties/core/deployments/97-v2*.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l   # expect 0
cast call 0x5CfbE713d070e87F67D1bc84312B7eB8Fe4F2B5E 'isScamWord(string,string)(bool,bool)' USDT USDT --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect true true
cast call 0x5CfbE713d070e87F67D1bc84312B7eB8Fe4F2B5E 'isScamWord(string,string)(bool,bool)' 'Proof Jar' PJAR --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect false false
cast balance 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect >=500000000000000000
{ [ -s .cache/flap-redeploy/start-balance.txt ] || cast balance 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --rpc-url "$RPC" > .cache/flap-redeploy/start-balance.txt; } && cat .cache/flap-redeploy/start-balance.txt
{ [ -s .cache/flap-redeploy/start-nonce.txt ] || cast nonce 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --rpc-url "$RPC" > .cache/flap-redeploy/start-nonce.txt; } && cat .cache/flap-redeploy/start-nonce.txt

# 2 the BNB pile pair (2 tx: PileVaultFactory naming the next address, then CurveLauncherFactory)
[ -e bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2.json ] && [ "$(cast code $(jq -r .curveLauncherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2.json) --rpc-url "$RPC")" != "0x" ] && { echo "already deployed: bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2.json names a launcher factory with code; never send this step twice"; exit 1; } || echo "not deployed yet"
( cd bounties/flap && DEPLOYMENTS_FILE=deployments/97-v2.json forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow )
( cd bounties/flap && DEPLOYMENTS_FILE=deployments/97-v2.json forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --broadcast )
[ "$(cast code $(jq -r .curveLauncherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2.json) --rpc-url "$RPC")" != "0x" ] && echo code || echo none   # expect code
[ "$(cast code $(jq -r .pileVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2.json) --rpc-url "$RPC")" != "0x" ] && echo code || echo none   # expect code
[ "$(echo $(cast call $(jq -r .pileVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2.json) 'pairedLauncherFactory()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") | tr A-Z a-z)" = "$(echo $(jq -r .curveLauncherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2.json) | tr A-Z a-z)" ] && echo same || echo differs   # expect same
[ "$(echo $(cast call $(jq -r .curveLauncherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2.json) 'pileVaultFactory()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") | tr A-Z a-z)" = "$(echo $(jq -r .pileVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2.json) | tr A-Z a-z)" ] && echo same || echo differs   # expect same
[ "$(echo $(cast call $(jq -r .curveLauncherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2.json) 'antiScam()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") | tr A-Z a-z)" = "$(echo 0x5CfbE713d070e87F67D1bc84312B7eB8Fe4F2B5E | tr A-Z a-z)" ] && echo same || echo differs   # expect same
[ "$(cast code $(cast call $(jq -r .pileVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2.json) 'beacon()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") --rpc-url "$RPC")" != "0x" ] && echo code || echo none   # expect code
[ "$(cast code $(cast call $(jq -r .pileVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2.json) 'beaconImplementation()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") --rpc-url "$RPC")" != "0x" ] && echo code || echo none   # expect code

# 3 the test-dollar pile pair (2 tx: TokenPileVaultFactory, then TokenCurveLauncherFactory)
[ -e bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-usdt.json ] && [ "$(cast code $(jq -r .tokenCurveLauncherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-usdt.json) --rpc-url "$RPC")" != "0x" ] && { echo "already deployed: bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-usdt.json names a launcher factory with code; never send this step twice"; exit 1; } || echo "not deployed yet"

[ "$(cast code $(jq -r .tokenCurveLauncherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-usdt.json) --rpc-url "$RPC")" != "0x" ] && echo code || echo none   # expect code
[ "$(cast code $(jq -r .tokenPileVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-usdt.json) --rpc-url "$RPC")" != "0x" ] && echo code || echo none   # expect code
[ "$(echo $(cast call $(jq -r .tokenPileVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-usdt.json) 'pairedLauncherFactory()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") | tr A-Z a-z)" = "$(echo $(jq -r .tokenCurveLauncherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-usdt.json) | tr A-Z a-z)" ] && echo same || echo differs   # expect same

# 6 the card shop factory with the guarded refill (1 tx) -> bounties/core/deployments/97-v2-rail-shop.json
[ -e bounties/core/deployments/97-v2-rail-shop.json ] && [ "$(cast code $(jq -r .factory bounties/core/deployments/97-v2-rail-shop.json) --rpc-url "$RPC")" != "0x" ] && { echo "already deployed: bounties/core/deployments/97-v2-rail-shop.json names a factory with code; never send this step twice"; exit 1; } || echo "not deployed yet"
( cd bounties/core && RAIL_SHOP_FILE=deployments/97-v2-rail-shop.json forge script script/DeployRailShopFactory.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow )
( cd bounties/core && RAIL_SHOP_FILE=deployments/97-v2-rail-shop.json forge script script/DeployRailShopFactory.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --broadcast )

cast call $(jq -r .factory bounties/core/deployments/97-v2-rail-shop.json) 'acceptedRouters()(address[])' --rpc-url "$RPC" | tr -d '[] '   # expect 0xc9D63ddCB9549578057EAB6A83a543DdFEE2b8c3,0xD99D1c33F9fC3444f8101754aBC46c52416550D1
cast call $(jq -r .factory bounties/core/deployments/97-v2-rail-shop.json) 'acceptedCollections()(address[])' --rpc-url "$RPC" | tr -cd ',' | wc -c   # expect 3

# 7 the stake factory of this tree (1 tx) -> bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-stake.json
[ -e bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-stake.json ] && [ "$(cast code $(jq -r .factory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-stake.json) --rpc-url "$RPC")" != "0x" ] && { echo "already deployed: bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-stake.json names a factory with code; never send this step twice"; exit 1; } || echo "not deployed yet"
( cd bounties/flap && STAKE_FILE=deployments/97-v2-stake.json forge script script/DeployStake.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow )
( cd bounties/flap && STAKE_FILE=deployments/97-v2-stake.json forge script script/DeployStake.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --broadcast )

cast call $(jq -r .factory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-stake.json) 'MIN_PERIOD()(uint256)' --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect 3600
python3 -I -c "import sys; c,h,b=(x.lower().removeprefix('0x') for x in sys.argv[1:4]); print('this build' if c.replace(h,'0'*64)==b else 'differs')" $(cast code $(jq -r .factory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-stake.json) --rpc-url "$RPC") $(cast call $(jq -r .factory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-stake.json) 'STAKE_CODE_HASH()(bytes32)' --rpc-url "$RPC") $(jq -r .deployedBytecode.object bounties/flap/out/RailStakeFactory.sol/RailStakeFactory.json)   # expect this build
[ "$(echo $(cast call $(jq -r .factory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-stake.json) 'STAKE_CODE_HASH()(bytes32)' --rpc-url "$RPC") | tr A-Z a-z)" = "$(echo 0x83fa432f07ebd62940e95f088155d065b147ef3c040c09266b23e7ea367b7981 | tr A-Z a-z)" ] && echo same || echo differs   # expect differs

# 26 Proof Jar: dispatch the tax processor's waiting vault share to the splitter (a measured zero is fine)
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=native SALE_FILE=deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json ACTION=dispatch forge script script/RulesSale.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow )
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=native SALE_FILE=deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json ACTION=dispatch forge script script/RulesSale.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --broadcast )
cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'ruleCount()(uint256)' --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect 3

# 27 Proof Jar: before share-out 1: the pair's quote (WBNB) reserve (no transaction)
echo $(t=$(jq -r .token bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json); w=$(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .rulesVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native.json) 'router()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'WETH()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC"); r=$(cast call $(cast call $(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .rulesVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native.json) 'router()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'factory()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'getPair(address,address)(address)' $(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .rulesVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native.json) 'router()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'WETH()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") $(jq -r .token bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) --rpc-url "$RPC") 'getReserves()(uint112,uint112,uint32)' --rpc-url "$RPC" | cut -d' ' -f1); set -- $r; python3 -I -c "import sys; t,w,a,b=sys.argv[1:5]; print(b if int(t,16)<int(w,16) else a)" $t $w $1 $2) > .cache/flap-redeploy/reserve-1.txt && cat .cache/flap-redeploy/reserve-1.txt
[ "$(cat .cache/flap-redeploy/reserve-1.txt)" -gt 0 ] && echo pool || echo none   # expect pool

# 28 Proof Jar: share-out 1: the creator and the pile are paid; the swap guard buys one slice at once (at most 5 bps of the pair's quote reserve) and burns it; a burn part above the slice stays owed
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=native SALE_FILE=deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json ACTION=distribute forge script script/RulesSale.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow )
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=native SALE_FILE=deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json ACTION=distribute forge script script/RulesSale.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --broadcast )
cast block latest -f timestamp --rpc-url "$RPC" > .cache/flap-redeploy/bought-at.txt && cat .cache/flap-redeploy/bought-at.txt
cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'delivered(uint256)(uint256)' 0 --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect >=1
cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'delivered(uint256)(uint256)' 1 --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect >=1
cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'burned(uint256)(uint256)' 2 --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect >=1
python3 -I -c "import sys; d,o,q=map(int,sys.argv[1:4]); c=q*5//10000; print('exact' if d==min(d+o,c) and (o==0 or d==c) else 'differs')" $(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'delivered(uint256)(uint256)' 2 --rpc-url "$RPC" | cut -d' ' -f1) $(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'owed(uint256)(uint256)' 2 --rpc-url "$RPC" | cut -d' ' -f1) $(cat .cache/flap-redeploy/reserve-1.txt)   # expect exact
echo $(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'burned(uint256)(uint256)' 2 --rpc-url "$RPC" | cut -d' ' -f1) > .cache/flap-redeploy/burned-1.txt && cat .cache/flap-redeploy/burned-1.txt

# 29 wait until the chain's time is 75 s past the last buy (the swap guard buys at most once a minute per contract; NOTHING may trade Proof Jar meanwhile), at most 5 minutes
at=$(cat .cache/flap-redeploy/bought-at.txt); end=$((SECONDS + 300)); while [ $SECONDS -lt $end ]; do now=$(timeout 20 cast block latest -f timestamp --rpc-url "$RPC" || echo 0); if [ "$now" -gt "$((at + 75))" ]; then echo "a minute has passed: bought at $at, the chain is at $now"; exit 0; fi; sleep 5; done; echo "the minute did not pass in 5 minutes"; exit 1
[ "$(cast block latest -f timestamp --rpc-url "$RPC")" -gt "$(( $(cat .cache/flap-redeploy/bought-at.txt) + 75 ))" ] && echo passed || echo not-yet   # expect passed

# 30 Proof Jar: before share-out 2: the pair's quote (WBNB) reserve, the owed burn part, what was bought so far (no transaction)
echo $(t=$(jq -r .token bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json); w=$(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .rulesVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native.json) 'router()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'WETH()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC"); r=$(cast call $(cast call $(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .rulesVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native.json) 'router()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'factory()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'getPair(address,address)(address)' $(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .rulesVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native.json) 'router()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'WETH()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") $(jq -r .token bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) --rpc-url "$RPC") 'getReserves()(uint112,uint112,uint32)' --rpc-url "$RPC" | cut -d' ' -f1); set -- $r; python3 -I -c "import sys; t,w,a,b=sys.argv[1:5]; print(b if int(t,16)<int(w,16) else a)" $t $w $1 $2) > .cache/flap-redeploy/reserve-2.txt && cat .cache/flap-redeploy/reserve-2.txt
echo $(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'owed(uint256)(uint256)' 2 --rpc-url "$RPC" | cut -d' ' -f1) > .cache/flap-redeploy/owed-2.txt && cat .cache/flap-redeploy/owed-2.txt
echo $(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'delivered(uint256)(uint256)' 2 --rpc-url "$RPC" | cut -d' ' -f1) > .cache/flap-redeploy/delivered-2.txt && cat .cache/flap-redeploy/delivered-2.txt
python3 -I -c "import sys; q,o=int(sys.argv[1]),int(sys.argv[2]); print(min(o, q*5//10000))" $(cat .cache/flap-redeploy/reserve-2.txt) $(cat .cache/flap-redeploy/owed-2.txt) > .cache/flap-redeploy/slice-2.txt && echo "the slice: min(owed, 5 bps of the reserve) = $(cat .cache/flap-redeploy/slice-2.txt)"
[ "$(cat .cache/flap-redeploy/slice-2.txt)" -gt 0 ] && echo slice || echo none   # expect slice

# 31 Proof Jar: share-out 2: the swap guard buys exactly the next slice (5 bps of the pair's quote reserve, or what is owed if less) and burns it; the rest stays owed
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=native SALE_FILE=deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json ACTION=distribute forge script script/RulesSale.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow )
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=native SALE_FILE=deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json ACTION=distribute forge script script/RulesSale.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --broadcast )
cast block latest -f timestamp --rpc-url "$RPC" > .cache/flap-redeploy/bought-at.txt && cat .cache/flap-redeploy/bought-at.txt
python3 -I -c "import sys; print('exact' if int(sys.argv[1])-int(sys.argv[2])==int(sys.argv[3]) else 'differs')" $(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'delivered(uint256)(uint256)' 2 --rpc-url "$RPC" | cut -d' ' -f1) $(cat .cache/flap-redeploy/delivered-2.txt) $(cat .cache/flap-redeploy/slice-2.txt)   # expect exact
python3 -I -c "import sys; o,b,c=map(int,sys.argv[1:4]); print('rest owed' if o>=b-c else 'differs')" $(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'owed(uint256)(uint256)' 2 --rpc-url "$RPC" | cut -d' ' -f1) $(cat .cache/flap-redeploy/owed-2.txt) $(cat .cache/flap-redeploy/slice-2.txt)   # expect rest owed
python3 -I -c "import sys; print('grew' if int(sys.argv[1])>int(sys.argv[2]) else 'differs')" $(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'burned(uint256)(uint256)' 2 --rpc-url "$RPC" | cut -d' ' -f1) $(cat .cache/flap-redeploy/burned-1.txt)   # expect grew
echo $(cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-v2-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'burned(uint256)(uint256)' 2 --rpc-url "$RPC" | cut -d' ' -f1) > .cache/flap-redeploy/burned-2.txt && cat .cache/flap-redeploy/burned-2.txt

# 32 Proof Jar: alice redeems 1,000,000 tokens from the pile
